OpenConnect for Mac
GitHubEN / RU

Work VPN on your Mac

SSO, the networks you need, and recovery after sleep. A native macOS menu, open source, built on OpenConnect.

InstallSource on GitHub ↗

I have a configured profile from a teammate →

Password and code filled in for you

Password and one-time code come from Keychain, KeePassXC or your own command. The sign-in window shows up only when a person is needed.

Work networks through VPN; everything else uses your usual connection

Only the networks in your profile go through the tunnel; everything else, home network included, goes the usual way. Switch them from the menu without reconnecting.

Smart DNS: yours and the company’s at once

Company domains resolve through the company DNS, everything else through yours. System DNS stays untouched.

An app, not a terminal

A native macOS menu: connect, pause, switch networks, read logs. A setup wizard and a profile editor; the CLI is there for automation.

Survives sleep and network changes

The supervisor brings the connection back after sleep, Wi-Fi changes and dropped links, without opening a sign-in window on its own.

Where it has been tested

Real connection: an AnyConnect-compatible gateway with Keycloak, macOS 26 on Apple Silicon. Used daily by the author.

Automated checks: ocserv and test SSO gateways. These do not confirm compatibility with real Okta or Microsoft Entra ID deployments.

Requires macOS 14.4+. Intel and macOS 14.4–15 have no real-device verification. A clean installation and first sign-in on another Mac have not been tested yet.

Tried your gateway? Tell us how it went →

A short report helps clarify compatibility. No company name, gateway address or sign-in details needed.

Install

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ValeraGin/openconnect-for-mac/main/install.sh)"

This command downloads the installer from GitHub. It offers to install missing Apple tools and Homebrew, installs OpenConnect for Mac and opens the app. The system helper needs your Mac administrator password.

macOS 14.4+ · access to an AnyConnect-compatible gateway
